metadata.name: win
metadata.description: (key, title, content) - make a draggable/resizable window in ONE step (emits the reactive geometry cels + a mounted view). =win("w1","Demo","drag my titlebar!")

metadata.name: window
metadata.description: (key, x, y, w, h, title, content) - a draggable/resizable window FRAME around content. Geometry (x/y/w/h) comes from the host's key.x/.y/.w/.h cels, so it's reactive + persists. Titlebar drags; corner resizes; body scrolls.

metadata.name: win.drag
metadata.description: the active drag/resize gesture {key,ox,oy,resize?} or null — module of the window manager's state, kept as a cel so it's reactive + dehydrates

metadata.name: win.grab
metadata.description: pointerdown handler (dispatch): start dragging window <key>; records the mouse->origin offset + captures the pointer

metadata.name: win.move
metadata.description: pointermove handler (dispatch): while dragging, setValue the window's x/y to track the pointer

metadata.name: win.grabResize
metadata.description: pointerdown handler (dispatch): start resizing window <key> from the corner handle

metadata.name: win.resizeMove
metadata.description: pointermove handler (dispatch): while resizing, setValue the window's w/h (min 120x80)

metadata.name: win.drop
metadata.description: pointerup handler (dispatch): end the drag/resize gesture (clears win.drag)

metadata.name: win.raise
metadata.description: pointerdown handler (dispatch): raise window <key> to the top of the z-order (bumps the reactive key.z cel)

metadata.name: win.list
metadata.description: the open-window registry (array of keys) — winopen/winclose maintain it; wintoolbar renders from it

metadata.name: winopen
metadata.description: (key, title) - register a window: add to win.list + seed its geometry cels (x/y/w/h/z/min/title) + raise

metadata.name: win.minimize
metadata.description: (key) - minimize: set key.min=1 (the window hides; its chip stays in the toolbar)

metadata.name: win.restore
metadata.description: (key) - restore a minimized window (key.min=0) + raise it

metadata.name: wintoolbar
metadata.description: (keys, titles) - a taskbar of open windows; click a chip to restore+raise. Pass win.list + the titles.
